Professional editing for academic success

Having a second set of eyes as you move into uncharted territory can be critical to your success.

The reality of academic life is that your supervisor won't always be available, or may be too overburdened by his or her own projects to give you the attention you need. This is especially important in the early draft phase of your work.

Get us involved. We'll help with your dissertation in progress, checking for style, clarity, organization, word choice, concision, and tone. We'll show you where you need to provide more support for your arguments and offer constructive criticism that will help you improve your writing. We will also do a first review of spelling, grammar, and typographical errors, cleaning up those distracting errors and allowing you to focus on creating great content.
